fiscal_note: Fiscal year ends on the Friday nearest June 30 (FY25 ended 2025-06-27, FY26 ended 2026-07-03, a 53-week year with a 14-week FQ1). Spin from WDC completed 2025-02-21 (trading as SNDK from 2025-02-24). All items are non-GAAP, total company, USD millions / percent / dollars per diluted share. FQ3 FY25 is included because Sandisk graded it against its own range on its first standalone call. That range's original issuance (believed to be the 2025-02-11 Investor Day, pre-spin) was not retrieved, so a score may exclude it. WDC's pre-spin Jan-2025 guidance is excluded. Sandisk guides tax and interest/other in dollars (e.g. FQ1 FY26 tax $35-40M vs $22M actual); the schema has no field for those. They are omitted except the FQ1 FY27 15.0% rate guide and a CFO 14-15% modeling comment graded on FQ3 FY26. Capex is guided only annually, so it appears under commitments. FQ3 FY25 and FQ4 FY25 call quotes come from AllMind auto-generated transcripts and may contain transcription errors; guidance numbers for those quarters are cross-checked against press releases where possible. For opex, an actual below the range is favorable.

commitments.target: Start qualifications at a third hyperscaler and a top storage OEM in CY2026
commitments.evidence: No explicit update on the third hyperscaler or storage OEM in later calls.
commitments.source: Sandisk PR 2025-11-06, SEC 8-K ex99.1 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2023554/000162828025050180/sndkq1fy26ex991-pressrelea.htm

commitments.speaker: David Goeckeler (CEO)
commitments.quote: We'll start shipping that for revenue in the next couple of quarters
commitments.target: Stargate (BiCS8 QLC) first revenue shipments within ~2 quarters
commitments.evidence: Began shipping for revenue in FQ4 FY26 per 2026-08-05 call.
commitments.source: FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q2, call 2026-01-29; FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q4, call 2026-08-05

commitments.speaker: Luis Visoso (CFO)
commitments.quote: $600 million this quarter, and we'll continue to take that down.
commitments.target: Continue paying down remaining ~$600M term loan B
commitments.evidence: Remaining $650M TLB balance repaid in FQ3 FY26 (2026-04-30 call; zero-debt balance sheet per PR). No date was stated.
commitments.source: FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q2, call 2026-01-29; FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q3, call 2026-04-30

commitments.speaker: David Goeckeler (CEO)
commitments.quote: Looking ahead to the fiscal fourth quarter, we expect to begin shipping our QLC Stargate solutions for revenue
commitments.target: Stargate revenue shipments begin in FQ4 FY26
commitments.evidence: 2026-08-05: 'this quarter, we began shipping our QLC Stargate platform for revenue'.
commitments.source: FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q3, call 2026-04-30; FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q4, call 2026-08-05

commitments.speaker: Luis Visoso (CFO)
commitments.quote: These five new business models account for over a third of our bits in fiscal year 2027, which we expect to increase
commitments.target: Raise NBM share of FY27 bits above one-third
commitments.evidence: 2026-08-05: NBMs expected to be more than 50% of FY27 bits (10 agreements, 8 customers).
commitments.source: FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q3, call 2026-04-30; FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q4, call 2026-08-05

commitments.speaker: Luis Visoso (CFO)
commitments.quote: our board of directors has authorized a $6 billion share buyback program ... effective immediately with no expiration date.
commitments.target: Execute $6B share repurchase
commitments.evidence: $4.5B (2.836M shares) repurchased in FQ4 FY26; additional $14B authorized 2026-08-05, $15.5B remaining. No deadline given.
commitments.source: FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q3, call 2026-04-30; FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q4, call 2026-08-05

commitments.speaker: Luis Visoso (CFO)
commitments.quote: NBMs to represent more than 50% of our bits in fiscal year 2027, and approximately 2/3 of our bits in fiscal year 2028.
commitments.target: NBMs >50% of FY27 bits and ~2/3 of FY28 bits
commitments.evidence: Not yet due.
commitments.source: FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q4, call 2026-08-05

commitments.speaker: Luis Visoso (CFO)
commitments.quote: yet our investment relative to revenue will come down to approximately 6% for the full year.
commitments.target: FY27 capex ~6% of revenue (up y/y in dollars for BiCS8/BiCS10)
commitments.evidence: Not yet due.
commitments.source: FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q4, call 2026-08-05

commitments.speaker: Luis Visoso (CFO)
commitments.quote: The higher inventory levels reduce sellable bits to mid-teens for the full year fiscal year 2027.
commitments.target: FY27 sellable bit growth mid-teens
commitments.evidence: Not yet due.
commitments.source: FMP transcript SNDK FY2026 Q4, call 2026-08-05
